subject.title: fix: clear stale Claude CLI sessions after failover

question: Should channel and follow-up Claude CLI runs clear the reused binding on both FailoverError and AbortError before this PR lands?
rationale: The patch is a focused bug fix, but it changes persisted session-state cleanup policy on failure paths and can intentionally drop a reusable Claude CLI binding during upgrade.

options.title: Accept command-path parity
options.body: Land the PR with both FailoverError and AbortError cleanup because it matches the existing command-attempt stale-session policy and fixes the linked retry loop.

options.title: Narrow to FailoverError only
options.body: Ask for the helper to clear only FailoverError if maintainers do not want channel-runner AbortError to invalidate reused Claude CLI bindings.

options.title: Require live transport proof
options.body: Pause merge until a redacted live gateway or Telegram failover run shows the stale-loop recovery end to end.

recommendation.title: Accept command-path parity
recommendation.body: Land the PR with both FailoverError and AbortError cleanup because it matches the existing command-attempt stale-session policy and fixes the linked retry loop.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is tied to the CLI backend/session reuse feature history and recent touched runner helpers, making them the best available owner for the persisted-session policy choice.
